args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is unset, and this fallback is used to build the password reset link (and other links) in passwordResetEmail. If PUBLIC_URL isn't configured correctly in the production environment, users receive emails pointing at localhost. Ensure PUBLIC_URL is set for the production deployment, and consider making BASE_URL fail loudly (e.g. throw or log an error) when PUBLIC_URL is missing in non-development environments, rather than silently falling back to localhost. This would prevent broken reset links like the ones reported from reaching real users.
